text: ふー　ノートの　なかの　こと　わたし　ぜんぶ　おぼえるの

structure.jp: ノートの　なかの　こと
わたし　ぜんぶ　おぼえるの
structure.en: I'm going to memorize all of it

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the very end of a sentence gives a soft, explaining tone, often used by girls and women. おぼえるの = 'I'm going to memorize it, you see'.
